body_markdown:
OLATHE, Kan./Oct. 15, 2026 – Garmin (NYSE: GRMN) today announced two new integrations with flyGarmin.com, making it easier for aircraft owners to share flight logs with additional analysis services. Class A and Coflyt ** have joined the growing list of analysis services that enable pilots to automatically share aircraft flight logs from their Garmin avionics and gain insights in many different areas including personalized insurance coverage, maintenance tracking, customized reports on engine health, flight analysis and more. These integrations, coupled with[PlaneSync](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/p/664160/) ™ service, allow aircraft owners to get the most out of the data their Garmin avionics collect every flight.


#### **A better way to log each flight**


From startup to shutdown, compatible Garmin avionics can collect a wealth of information about each flight. When appropriately equipped, an aircraft flight log can include GPS track, attitude information, engine data, aircraft total time, departure time, carbon monoxide levels and more. Following the flight, the data can be automatically uploaded to flyGarmin.com via the GDL® 60 datalink and PlaneSync service1. Data can also be transferred from compatible avionics or via the Flight Stream 510 wireless gateway, which transfers aircraft flight logs to the Garmin Pilot app for upload to flyGarmin.com. Aircraft owners can access their flight logs via flyGarmin.com, where they can review flights, playback data and more. A list of compatible avionics can be found at[Garmin.com/FlightLogs](http://garmin.com/FlightLogs) .


#### **Gain deeper insights through analysis services**


With the flyGarmin.com integrations, aircraft owners can opt in to share their flight logs automatically with the service providers they select. Examples include aircraft and flight analysis, engine performance and trend analysis, aircraft record keeping and maintenance services, aircraft scheduling and more.


#### **New integrations**


Garmin customers now have access to 12 integrated analysis and management services through flyGarmin.com. New integrations include:


Class A: A technology-driven aviation insurance carrier that uses real-world flight data analytics to support smarter underwriting and personalized coverage. Through Garmin flight log integration, Class A is launching a FOQA/FDM capability as part of its Virtual Flight Department (VFD), which provides aircraft owners with resources typically available only to large professional flight departments.


Coflyt: A cloud-based aircraft management platform that centralizes inspection and maintenance tracking, AD compliance, squawk sheets, scheduling, utilization and flight data, payments and communications in a single system.


Additional flyGarmin.com integrations include: FlySto, Crewchief Systems, Savvy Aviation, Navi, Brazos Safety Systems, Jet-Care, Pilotbase, TBX, PLANELOGIX and AircraftMX. Together, these services support everything from flight school scheduling and maintenance tracking to aircraft recordkeeping and engine analysis.


All data analysis integrations are managed through flyGarmin.com. Once sharing is enabled, all current and future flight logs for the selected aircraft will be automatically shared with the service provider. Access to future logs can be changed at any time. Aircraft flight logs are available on flyGarmin.com today for aircraft owners using compatible Garmin avionics. For additional information, visit[Garmin.com/FlightLogs](https://www.garmin.com/en-US/aviation/aircraft-flight-logs/) .


Garmin products and services have revolutionized flight and become essential to the lives of pilots and aircraft owners and operators around the world. A leading provider of solutions to general aviation, business aviation, rotorcraft, advanced air mobility, government and defense, and commercial air carrier customers, Garmin believes every day is an opportunity to innovate.
